Economy · India

Indian stock markets open higher amid global uncertainty

Indian stock markets, including the Sensex and Nifty, opened with significant gains on Tuesday. The Sensex saw an increase of nearly 500 points. This rise occurred despite mixed global cues and headwinds from crude oil prices. Analysts suggest the markets are looking towards a positive opening, indicating investor optimism despite external economic factors.
